name: Steel Defender
hit_points_formula: 5 + five times your Artificer level (the defender has a number of Hit Dice [d8s] equal to your Artificer level)

traits.name: Steel Bond
traits.description: Add the creator’s Proficiency Bonus to the defender’s ability checks and saving throws.

actions.name: Force-Empowered Rend
actions.description: Melee spell attack; on a hit, deal 1d8 + 2 + Intelligence modifier Force damage.

actions.name: Repair (3/Day)
actions.description: Restore 2d8 + Intelligence modifier Hit Points to itself or a nearby Construct or object.

reactions.name: Deflect Attack
reactions.description: Impose Disadvantage on a nearby attack against a creature other than the defender.

description: Reference stat block from Eberron: Forge of the Artificer, page 19.
